license_required.quote: The license of any dentist or dental hygienist to practice dentistry or dental hygiene in this state shall be subject to restriction, suspension, revocation, stipulation or may otherwise be limited

issuing_authority.value: New Mexico Board of Dental Health Care
issuing_authority.quote: "board" means the New Mexico board of dental health care

name.value: New Mexico Board of Dental Health Care
name.quote: "board" means the New Mexico board of dental health care

type.quote: "board" means the New Mexico board of dental health care

available.quote: A board that issues an occupational or professional license shall, as soon as practicable but no later than thirty days after an out-of-state licensee files a complete application for an expedited license

requirements.value: Expedited licensure available for out-of-state licensees who hold a current and in good standing license from another licensing jurisdiction, have practiced and held an active license for the period required by NM law, and provide fingerprints/background check if required.
requirements.quote: holds a license that is current and in good standing issued by another licensing jurisdiction; has practiced and held an active license in the profession or occupation for which expedited licensure is sought for a period required by New Mexico law

exists.quote: "dental hygienists committee" means the New Mexico dental hygienists committee

name.quote: "dental hygienists committee" means the New Mexico dental hygienists committee

authority.value: When the licensee being considered for action is a dental hygienist, the board shall act upon recommendation of the dental hygienists committee on all aspects of procedures in the Impaired Dentists and Dental Hygienists Act.
authority.quote: the board shall act upon recommendation of the dental hygienists committee on all aspects of procedures in the Impaired Dentists and Dental Hygienists Act

national_association.quote: the board may consider nominations from the New Mexico dental association for the dentist member

regulatory_model.quote: The license of any dentist or dental hygienist to practice dentistry or dental hygiene in this state shall be subject to restriction, suspension, revocation, stipulation or may otherwise be limited

credential_type.quote: "licensee" means a dentist or dental hygienist licensed by the board

is_mandatory.quote: "licensee" means a dentist or dental hygienist licensed by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to mental illness
Inability to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to physical illness, including deterioration through aging or loss of motor skills
disciplinary_grounds.quote: physical illness, including but not limited to deterioration through the aging process or loss of motor skill

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs as defined in the Controlled Substances Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs, as defined in the Controlled Substances Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of alcohol
disciplinary_grounds.quote: habitual or excessive use or abuse of alcohol

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any conditions of a voluntary limitation of practice statement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a violation of any of the conditions of the voluntary limitation of practice statement by such licensee shall be due cause for the refusal of renewal, or the suspension or revocation, of the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a licensee to comply with an examining committee order to appear for hearing or submit to mental or physical examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a licensee to comply with an examining committee order under Subsection B of this section to appear before it for hearing or to submit to mental or physical examination under this section shall be reported by the examining committee to the board or dental hygienists committee and, unless due to circumstances beyond the control of the licensee, shall be grounds for the immediate and summary suspension

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing conversion therapy to any person under eighteen years of age
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person licensed pursuant to provisions of Chapter 61 NMSA 1978 shall not provide conversion therapy to any person under eighteen years of age. The provision of conversion therapy in violation of the provisions of this subsection shall be grounds for disciplinary action

definition_quote.value: the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene
definition_quote.quote: "dentistry or dental hygiene" means the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene
